sequencing: Exploratory POST earlier species-aggregate and site-matched photo outcomes, NOT a preregistered independent confirmation. Freeze this algebra, support and all-taxon reporting BEFORE opening NEW common-support within-vs-composition values.
ecological_question: Do reported seasonal changes in the apparent NIGHT share of Serengeti camera photos arise primarily from changes within a station's photographed diel schedule, from changes in which camera stations contribute photographs, or both?
justification: The camera survey covers the spatially variable Serengeti plains/woodlands migration zone; known zebra/wildebeest migration follows rainfall. Distinguishing where animals are photographed from when animals are photographed is a genuinely ecological interpretation problem, not proof of movement or resource causality.

labels.rising: Before December 21 at original retained sunrise/sunset-matched days
labels.falling: After December 21 at same frozen site/year mirror dates
labels.night: Outside original site's computed daily sunrise-to-sunset; civil twilight OUTSIDE daylight included as night
labels.daylight: All sunrise-to-sunset daylight including central and edge daytime

estimand.unit: Species × December-solstice year, within single original Serengeti ecological landscape
estimand.sample: Common physical camera roster C where species has >=1 source photo event BOTH rising and falling for that calendar cycle. Common support is DETECTION-SELECTED; all structural camera sites and unmatched coverage must be reported separately. No pseudocounting.
estimand.per_camera: n_ib source PHOTO night events, d_ib source PHOTO daylight events, N_ib=n_ib+d_ib>0, p_ib=n_ib/N_ib
estimand.weights: w_ib=N_ib/sum_{j in C}N_jb, for b=rising/falling, sum_i w_ib=1
estimand.delta: Δ P_common = sum_i [w_iF p_iF − w_iR p_iR] over common source photographed cameras
estimand.identity: W+B = ΔP_common exactly, tolerant only to 1e-12 floating arithmetic
estimand.common_support_selection: eligible common cameras selected on presence of source photographs; report source PHOTO proportions covered of total branch records, NOT effort-standardized detections
estimand.source_camera_turnover: TV_station=0.5*sum_i abs(w_iF-w_iR) on common photographed camera set; descriptive photo-location shift NOT actual animal movement
estimand.missing_site_coverage: Report N_sites_rising, N_sites_falling, N_common_sites, unmatched_photo_fraction_per_branch. Pooled all-site delta and common-only delta must be reported separately; no algebra claiming all-site change decomposed by W/B.
estimand.denominator: Zero-photo branch cameras remain in observed all-site denominators and eligibility audits; only C common roster supports W/B. Low or undefined common support yields undefined W and B.

outputs.all_taxa: All 43 source taxon labels, including bird labels and source spellings; all three years; retain low-support/undefined/negative results.
outputs.support_context: Prespecified descriptive attention if common camera count >=20, fraction of both rising/falling ORIGINAL photographed records on common roster >=0.5, and recorded source events >=100 each branch; label as descriptive support only.
outputs.year_summary: Each year separately, no data-driven year picking; optional all-cycles camera-averaged descriptive median of W/B over years but no inference.

null_limits: Station photograph weights can change because true animal distribution, camera observation uptime/q, density, habitat visibility, camera vegetation, camera setup, and weather change. Calling B true spatial migration is NOT identified.
Within-camera photographed p may change because q differs by time and season; W is not direct animal diel plasticity.
The common-photo roster itself selects on positive outcomes, possibly large bias; the all-camera population/latent activity cannot be inferred.
No source-verified device-hour operating intervals or independent q; even all-site total photo proportions are not unbiased exposure-based activity rates.
No independent new-region transfer, ecological significance tests, individual animal samples, or causal climate/NDVI/food evidence.
Within/B terms can be opposite sign or small; zero, mixed, positive and negative outcomes must all be retained.
Site-year camera occurrences are correlated within one landscape. Number of cameras != independent ecological landscapes.
